summary: Component I1 of the plan docs/plans/wave-integration-2026-10.md (decision D3, ADR-0147). The spec is docs/architecture/wave-orchestrator.md section 15. The orchestrator orders the deliverables of a wave by a deterministic score. The first key is the deps: a producer composes before its consumer. The next keys are the conflict graph, the inbox rank and the count of items that it unblocks. The last keys are low risk, low verification cost and the time of delivery.
